result: In `uart_rx_core`, replace the three repeated pairwise-AND/OR majority expressions with one shared `majority_vote` wire, expressed as `(vote_a & vote_b) | ((vote_a | vote_b) & line_sample)`. Use that same value for start-bit validation, data-bit capture, and stop-bit validation. Preserve the existing vote sample edges, state transitions, data-bit ordering, registered outputs, reset behavior, and supported `OVERSAMPLE_DIV` timing.
